decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's mental-health support portfolio and now promoted on the home page, outpatient sociotherapy looks strategically important and likely established enough to retain.
Counseling for senior living fits the firm's eldercare focus very well and its continued home-page visibility suggests strong relevance and low withdrawal risk.

The sheltered-workshop retail shop supports the firm's social-inclusion mission and gained prominence in 2024, so it is more likely to be maintained than closed despite being somewhat less core than care services.

Meal delivery for seniors matches the firm's needs-based support approach, but as a very new offer with only limited website prominence it carries a higher test-phase discontinuation risk than the other current products.
